<title level="1" right="Condition">[Observed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=84)</title>

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 444

Anything in plain view is observed by you. If a creature takes measures to avoid detection, such as by using [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=62), it can become [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=22) or [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=39) instead of observed. If you have another [precise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) besides sight, you might be able to observe a creature or object using that sense instead. You can observe a creature with only your precise senses. When [Seeking](/Actions.aspx?ID=84) a creature using only imprecise senses, it remains hidden, rather than observed.
